description: Model routing rules based on latency measurements

Chef.routing_logic: Always use GPT-5 for text responses

Accountant.routing_logic: Use Gemini 2.5 Pro for SQL generation and analytics
Accountant.notes: Optimized for structured data and database queries

Research.routing_logic: Primary: Perplexity for web search. Fallback: GPT-5 on API errors
Research.notes: Fastest response, includes citations from web sources

Media.routing_logic: Async job creation with Imagen-3, returns jobId immediately
Media.notes: 1.7s for job creation (not full generation). Fastest async workflow.

optimization_opportunities: Chef role could benefit from streaming responses to reduce perceived latency
Accountant role SQL execution time not included in latency (query-dependent)
Research role has built-in retry logic (3 attempts) for reliability
